beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An interface around a public model can be a sensible starting experiment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It can reveal a neglected task and establish that someone values the result.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book’s warning concerns what happens after that initial discovery.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A larger platform may bundle the same visible function into an existing relationship.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The original company then needs reasons for customers to keep choosing it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Deployment knowledge, lawful data rights, and difficult integrations may strengthen that position.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The relevant question is whether early activity produces assets that compound.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That moves the discussion beyond celebrating either fast entry or technical difficulty alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book turns its thesis into questions an investor or builder can inspect.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: What remains valuable if the underlying model becomes cheaper or interchangeable?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Does each deployment improve evaluations, integrations, distribution, or institutional knowledge?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Who bears verification costs when the generated output turns out to be wrong?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Customer responsibility does not automatically become a defensible asset for the vendor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Likewise, revenue growth alone does not establish a lasting strategic position.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These distinctions help readers interrogate an appealing demonstration without dismissing its usefulness.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The chapter reserves the fuller discussion of ownership and return paths for careful reading.
